title: Imperial Envoys
next_chapter_hook: The Ultimate Chessmaster's board has been laid out, and Chen Ji is about to step into the forbidden land that determines fate.

text.content:
Golden light surged like a tide from the horizon's end, cascading down and shrouding the entire Tianqing Sect in an atmosphere of solemn killing intent. Chen Ji stood in the Servants' Quarters, gazing up at the figure descending from the heavens. The Tianji Record Fragment at his brow center trembled violently, as if warning him of something.

That figure was wreathed in golden radiance, each strand containing world-destroying power. Chen Ji narrowed his eyes, feeling a pressure that transcended his comprehension—this force even surpassed that of the Tianqing Sect's Sect Master.

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji, this one has been waiting for you for a long time.

The figure descended slowly, golden light swirling around him, his majestic countenance suffocating. His voice was not loud, yet it clearly reached everyone present, carrying the undeniable majesty of imperial authority.

Thetrash Chen Ji, meeting you today, truly lives up to your reputation. That golden pupil flickered with a hint of playfulness. Yourtrash persona is quite convincingly acted.

text.content:
Chen Ji felt that intangible pressure, yet his heart was unexpectedly calm. He knew this moment would come eventually, but didn't expect it so soon.

An Imperial Envoy has graced us with his presence—what merit does Chen Ji possess? He slightly clasped his hands in salute, wearing his usual timid expression, yet his voice remained neither servile nor arrogant. I wonder what brings the esteemed Envoy to seek this insignificant servant?

dialogue.content:
The Imperial Envoy coldly snorted, a flash of disdain flickering in those golden pupils. Stop your pretensions—do you think this one doesn't know your true nature?

He suddenly stepped forward, golden radiance surging around him, forming a visible pressure ring. The Tianji Record Fragment resides in your Mental Sea—this is the arrangement of the Ultimate Chessmaster. This one comes on orders to retrieve what belongs to the board.

text.content:
Ultimate Chessmaster?

Chen Ji's heart shook—this name he heard for the first time. The Tianji Record Fragment in his Mental Sea radiated gentle warmth, as if responding to something. He suddenly realized the truth he had been seeking might be right before his eyes.

Seeing his silence, the Imperial Envoy's lips curved into a mocking arc. What, scared? The will of the Ultimate Chessmaster—can a mere ant like you dare defy it?

choice.prompt: The Imperial Envoy presses forward step by step, and Chen Ji faces his first choice: how to respond to this threat far beyond expectations?

choices.description: Directly admit to possessing the Tianji Record Fragment, retreat to advance and probe the other party's bottom line
choices.visible_reward: Gather Intelligence on the Ultimate Chessmaster
choices.risk_hint: Risk Having the Tianji Record Forcibly Taken

text.content: A sharp glint flashed in Chen Ji's eyes, then his usual weak demeanor returned. Since the esteemed Envoy already knows, Chen Ji will not hide. Indeed, the Tianji Record Fragment is indeed in my Mental Sea. It's just that this Ultimate Chessmaster... what kind of great being could it possibly be?

dialogue.content: The Imperial Envoy's brow slightly furrowed, clearly not expecting him to be so candid. You're sensible enough, however... the name of the Ultimate Chessmaster is not something you may casually inquire about? He coldly laughed. You merely need to know that you are but one piece on the board.

choices.description: Cling tightly to thetrash persona without letting go, stall for time while secretly laying plans
choices.risk_hint: Provoking the Envoy's Wrath Would Have Serious Consequences

text.content: Chen Ji's face showed confusion, his body trembling slightly. D-dearest sir speaks of what? Tianji Record? T-this servant is merely an Outer Disciple/Servant, where would I have seen any Tianji Record...

dialogue.content: A cold light flashed in the Imperial Envoy's eyes. A contemptible ant dares perform on stage before this one? He suddenly raised his hand, a beam of golden light shooting forth, aiming directly at Chen Ji's brow center. Consider this a small test—let's see how you react.

choices.description: Directly question the relationship between the Dynasty and the Ultimate Chessmaster, demonstrate your own value
choices.risk_hint: Risk Being Killed on the Spot

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly smiled, that smile carrying an indefinable meaning. Since the esteemed Envoy knows the Tianji Record is in my Mental Sea, surely you also know its uses. You say I'm a piece, but would the Ultimate Chessmaster truly bear to destroy this piece?

dialogue.content: The Imperial Envoy's expression slightly changed, a flicker of surprise passing through those golden pupils. He hadn't expected thistrash disciple to dare speak in such a manner. Bold! He coldly snorted. But do you think this gives you the right to negotiate with this one?

The Imperial Envoy stood with hands clasped behind his back, golden light flowing around him, rendering him like a deity descended. What do you think the Dynasty is? The supreme ruler of the empire? He coldly laughed. The Dynasty is merely a piece placed by the Ultimate Chessmaster in this world, and you, the inheritor of the Tianji Record, are a piece among pieces.

text.content:
Chen Ji heard this, his heart shaken beyond measure. So that's how it is... he murmured to himself. The Dynasty, Sects, Demonic Path—all forces are merely pieces on the board. And the Tianji Record—that's what the Ultimate Chessmaster truly wants.

The Tianji Record quivered violently in his Mental Sea, seemingly responding to this terrifying truth.

dialogue.content: The Ultimate Chessmaster has been watching you for a long time, Chen Ji. The Imperial Envoy's voice turned low and grim. From the moment you obtained the Tianji Record, you were drawn into the game. This one comes to give you a chance—submit, or die.

choice.prompt: The Ultimate Chessmaster's will is laid before Chen Ji, and he must decide: how to face this enemy that transcends all?

choices.description: First stabilize the Imperial Envoy,潜伏 in the enemy's ranks and wait for the opportune moment

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath and slowly knelt. Chen Ji is willing to submit to the Dynasty, to heed the Ultimate Chessmaster's调配. He lowered his head, yet a subtle cold glint flickered in his eyes.

dialogue.content: The Imperial Envoy nodded in satisfaction. A wise person knows when to yield. Since you are willing to submit, this one can ensure you have a place in the Dynasty. However... his tone shifted. The Tianji Record must be handed over to this one's keeping.

choices.description: Rather die than submit, display true pride, even knowing you're no match, never compromise
choices.visible_reward: Maintain Dignity, Earn Respect from Future Allies
choices.risk_hint: Risk Being Killed on the Spot

text.content: Chen Ji slowly stood up, the timidity on his face swept clean away, replaced by an unprecedented calm. Esteemed Envoy, though Chen Ji is atrash, I also know there are things one must not do, even at the cost of death.

dialogue.content: A flash of surprise crossed the Imperial Envoy's eyes, followed by undisguised killing intent. You won't drink the toast offered? He slapped forward with one palm, a golden palm seal blotted out the sky as it bore down on Chen Ji.

choices.description: Demonstrate your own value, establish the possibility of equal dialogue with the Ultimate Chessmaster
choices.risk_hint: Risk Being Prioritized as a Threat and Dealt With

text.content: Chen Ji stared directly into those golden pupils, speaking calmly. The Ultimate Chessmaster needs the Tianji Record because there are things it cannot do. Since that's the case, why doesn't the esteemed Envoy negotiate with me?

dialogue.content: The Imperial Envoy narrowed his eyes, as if re-examining the young man before him. Interesting, you actually dare negotiate with this one? He coldly laughed. Speak then—what do you want?

text.content:
Just as both sides were at a stalemate, the Tianji Record Fragment in Chen Ji's Mental Sea suddenly erupted with dazzling radiance. That light contained a power beyond the mortal realm, directly repelling the Imperial Envoy's pressure several steps.

The Envoy's expression drastically changed, gazing in disbelief at the golden runes appearing at Chen Ji's brow center. This is... Heavenly Secrets Manifest?

dialogue.content: A hoary voice suddenly echoed in Chen Ji's mind: Foolish child, you have finally touched the edge of the truth. The Ultimate Chessmaster is not one person, but the embodiment of Heavenly Dao's will. It manipulates fate, weaves cause and effect, and the Tianji Record in your hands is the only thing that can break all this.

choice.prompt: Tianji Record Manifests, Mo Xiansheng Reveals Key Information, Chen Ji Must Make a Choice Amidst Shock

choices.description: With the power of Tianji Record's manifestation, tentatively launch an attack on the Imperial Envoy
choices.visible_reward: May Severely Wound the Envoy, Deter the Enemy
choices.risk_hint: Risk Drawing the Ultimate Chessmaster's Direct Attention

text.content: A sharp glint flashed in Chen Ji's eyes as he formed seals with both hands, the Tianji Record's power surging forth like a tide. A golden rune shot from his brow center, directly toward the Imperial Envoy's face.

dialogue.content: The Imperial Envoy coldly snorted, waving his sleeve, dispersing that golden rune. But his eyes had already gained a hint of wariness. The power of the Tianji Record... truly deserves its reputation. However, with your current level, it is far from enough.

choices.description: Use the chaos of Tianji Record's manifestation, immediately withdraw from the scene, preserve strength

text.content: Chen Ji seized this fleeting opportunity, his body暴retreating. Meanwhile, Ye Qing's Demonic Path mist quietly spread from his sleeve, shrouding his entire person within.

dialogue.content: The Imperial Envoy coldly snorted, attempting to pursue, yet discovered that Demonic Path mist to be extremely strange, actually able to completely shield the Tianji Record's aura. Running? He coldly laughed. You cannot escape—you will meet again.

choices.description: Temporarily shelve the confrontation with the Envoy, inquire of Mo Xiansheng for more intelligence on the Ultimate Chessmaster

text.content: Chen Ji ignored the Imperial Envoy, urgently asking in his heart: Mo Xiansheng, what do you mean by Heavenly Dao's will? What exactly is the relationship between the Ultimate Chessmaster and the Tianji Record in my hands?

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng's voice rang out again, imbued with endless vicissitudes. The Tianji Record was originally part of the Heavenly Dao, yet was torn away and fell into the mortal realm. The Ultimate Chessmaster wishes to reclaim it, thereby completely controlling fate. And you... are the Chess Player it has chosen.

The Imperial Envoy stood with hands clasped behind his back, golden light gradually subsiding, yet the threatening intent in his eyes grew ever stronger. Chen Ji, today's matter, this one will report truthfully to the Ultimate Chessmaster. His lips curved into a cold smile. The next time we meet, it won't be so easy on you.

With that, golden light flashed, and the Envoy vanished from where he stood.

text.content:
Chen Ji stood where he was, gazing at the direction where the Envoy had disappeared, long remaining speechless. Ye Qing's Demonic Path mist had already dissipated; her figure emerged from the shadows, her expression grave.

Ultimate Chessmaster... Heavenly Dao's will... Chen Ji murmured, his heart churning with惊天动地. From the very beginning, he had been drawn into a chess game spanning countless years.

dialogue.content:
Ye Qing walked to his side, rarely showing a trace of worry. Chen Ji, are you alright? The Dynasty's power far exceeds our imagination—if they truly act with full force...

Chen Ji turned to look at her, a complex light flickering in his eyes. But precisely for this reason, I have become even more certain of one thing.

text.content:
Chen Ji took a deep breath, his voice low and firm. The Dynasty is merely a lower-level piece of the Ultimate Chessmaster, and the Tianji Record... is the only thing that can break all this. He raised his head toward the void, as if staring directly at some formless existence. Ultimate Chessmaster, the thing you want—I will personally deliver it before you—though in my own way.

Ye Qing sensed the resolve in his words, her heart slightly shaken. At this moment, she saw a Chen Ji completely different from thetrash persona.

Deep night fell, the lights of Tianqing Sect gradually extinguished. Chen Ji stood alone atop the mountain peak, gazing at the surging clouds in the distance, replaying today's events endlessly in his mind.

Dynasty, Ultimate Chessmaster, Heavenly Dao's will... these terms intertwined in his heart, forming an unprecedented grand vision. He knew that from this moment on, the enemy he faced had completely changed.

But he felt no fear; instead, he felt an unprecedented clarity. Since the chess game has been revealed, let me be the one to place the pieces—Chen Ji said in a low voice, his eyes shining with firm light—one day, I will completely overturn this board.

The Tianji Record slowly quivered in his Mental Sea, seemingly responding to his determination. Mo Xiansheng's voice rang out again, carrying a hint of commendation: Foolish child, you have finally taken the first step. However, the road ahead is long—you must be mentally prepared—the Ultimate Chessmaster will not give you much time.

Chen Ji nodded, his gaze increasingly firm. He knew the true game had just begun, and he was already prepared to face whatever came.
